# Trail of Bits Skills — NOTICE

This directory is a vendored copy of the **Trail of Bits /skills** repository,
imported for reference and canonical-skill ingestion into the `data_rein`
harness.

- **Source:** https://github.com/trailofbits/skills
- **Revision (pinned):** `4db88ee79db0a68bbe049fe827e272ee2bc19510`
- **License:** CC-BY-SA-4.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

The skills are **shared-alike** — any distributed derivatives of these skills
must be offered under compatible terms and must carry this attribution. The
harness imports them into `skills/` where they are symlinked (not copied) into
each environment's scan path; runtime degrades gracefully for Claude-Code-only
features (subagents, slash commands, hooks) outside Claude Code.

Content provenance is also recorded in `../SBOM.json`.
